description: The CharGen playbook, by area. With no topic: the overview (how the tools compose, what is free and what costs gold, job polling, error handling) and the list of area guides. With a topic: that area's guide, such as world building, sessions, or art with how to write prompts for each image, video and audio model. Call this once when you first work with CharGen tools in a conversation, or whenever unsure which tool fits.

topic.description: Which guide to read; leave out for the overview. overview: what CharGen is, what is free and what costs Gold, job polling, errors, and this list. worldbuilding: the content generators, saving and editing library entries, the world graph, folders and workspaces. sessions: reading recaps and transcripts, logging a session nobody recorded, correcting a session's history. art: images, video, audio, 3D and pixel sprites: what costs Gold and how to write any prompt. Start here, then read the medium's guide. art_images: image rendering, image edits, workflows and pixel sprites, and how to write an image prompt for each model family. art_video: video from text, pictures and references, talking portraits and motion transfer, and how to write a video prompt. art_audio: speech, music and sound effects, and what the prompt is for each. art_3d: 3D models and the tools that change them.
